address: 115 St George's Terrace, Jesmond, Newcastle Upon Tyne, NE2 2DN, United Kingdom
bio: Head Chef Kleo is Albanian by birth and spent time in Italy before making the UK his home, so it’s no surprise to see the flavours and colours of the Mediterranean feature at this charming neighbourhood brasserie. There is a welcome lack of fussiness to the cooking – dishes burst with flavour and are designed for sharing, with sensibly priced wines from across Europe being an added plus. Lisa, his partner, looks after the service and is a natural hostess....
